$Comment: Percent bonus to every track gain the carrier earns (skill XP and any other climb whose track runs the Bonus factor; standing reads CategoryGain_Reputation instead), in whole percent points (10 is +10%). Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat (Additive on the Max), and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers, such as a meal. ziggfreed-common's Bonus gain factor adds it to CategoryGain_<Category> and TrackGain_<Track> (a pack ships those in this same shape, spelled as the category and the track file are named) and to any stat a mod names for the track, holds the total at the cap this file's ZigCeiling tag names (1000, so a gain grows to eleven times at most; it bounds these stats alone, never the boosts, which keep their own cap; nothing raises it, and a server changes it by shipping this file with another value), and adds the result beside the track's boosts. Base 0; Min -100, so a subtractive modifier can at most stop a gain.
